articles.summary: Frequently Asked Questions angela.wan+a Thu, 07/23/2026 - 15:49 SBA FAQ SBA Loan Programs Eligible borrowers are generally for-profit businesses operating in the United States that meet SBA size standards and lender requirements. The main SBA loan types include SBA 7(a) loans, SBA 504 loans and SBA Microloans. Each is designed for different business financing needs. SBA loans may be used for working capital, real estate, equipment, business acquisition and certain refinancing needs, depending on the program. The SBA does not set a single minimum credit score for all loans. Lenders review credit as part of the overall application. Loan amounts vary by loan program, financing purpose and borrower qualifications. Requirements vary, but lenders often request tax returns, financial statements, business details and ownership information. Some SBA loans may require collateral or a down payment, depending on the loan type and borrower profile. SBA FAQ EN

This honor reflects our ongoing commitment to our clients, team members, communities, and stakeholders. The America’s Best Companies ranking evaluates organizations based on three core dimensions: Employee satisfaction Financial performance Sustainability and ESG transparency Companies recognized on this list are selected through a rigorous process that includes the analysis of financial data, ESG metrics, and large-scale independent employee surveys involving approximately 217,000 workers nationwide. Our mission is centered on helping individuals, families, and businesses build strong financial foundations and unlock opportunities for growth. Over the decades, we’ve evolved alongside our communities, guided by the belief that banking is a trusted collaboration rooted in understanding, care, and long-term success. We are committed to fostering a workplace where team members feel professionally and personally valued, supported, and empowered. Driving Sustainable and Responsible Growth Cathay Bank’s inclusion on this list underscores our commitment to sustainability and responsible business practices. Our ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) performance is assessed through key indicators, including environmental impact, governance standards, and social responsibility initiatives. We recognize that long-term success relies on our contributions toward a more sustainable and equitable future, and we remain dedicated to continuous improvement in these areas. Looking Ahead As we look to the future, Cathay Bank remains focused on empowering those we serve to move forward with confidence. This recognition serves as both a milestone and a motivation to continue raising that bar.
